#include <stdio.h>
#include "bank.h"

#define MAX 3
#define SQ(x) ((x) * (x))

typedef struct acct {
    int id;
    char *name;
} acct_t;

enum color { RED, GREEN };

static int limit = 5;

int find(const char *id, int n) {
    char q[100];
    int i;
    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
        limit += j;
    }
    sprintf(q, "SELECT %s", id);
    struct acct a;
    a.id = 1;
    acct_t *p = &a;
    p->id = 2;
    return strlen(q);
lbl:
    goto lbl;
}

int (*fp)(int) = 0;
void apply(int (*cb)(int), int v);
